svg.title: The stack — layer by layer
svg.desc: Three stacked layers of a web system. Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router, Axios, Vitest and Testing Library. Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 4, Spring Security with JWT, Spring Data JPA, Bean Validation, Spring AI with tool calling and RAG, Maven, JUnit. Data and infrastructure: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, MySQL 8.4, Redis, Flyway, Docker Compose, Testcontainers, GitHub Actions, nginx. Beyond the web: C, Thumb-2 assembly, Cortex-M4, CMSIS-DSP, QEMU, Python ML, control systems. Foundations: DSA in Java, OOP, DBMS and SQL, computer networks.
